extracted.name: Absolute Stress
extracted.description: Mix rum and vodka with peach schnapps, orange juice, and cranberry juice for a quick and easy cocktail that will remove any traces of a stressful day!
instruction_lines: Fill a tall glass with ice.
Add vodka, rum, peach schnapps, orange juice, and cranberry juice to a cocktail shaker. Cover and shake well. Pour over ice.
